## Giant Sea Slug (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
 N Gargantuan vermin (aquatic)  

**Init** +4 **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 19, touch 6, flat-footed 19 (+13 natural, -4 size)  

**hp** 217 (15d8+90 plus 7)  

**Fort** +15, **Ref** +7, **Will** +7  

**Immune** vermin traits  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** swim 50 ft.  

**Melee** bite +19 (2d8+16 plus grab plus paralysis)  

**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  

**Special Attacks** capsize, paralysis (1d6 rounds, DC 23), swallow whole (2d8+16 bludgeoning damage plus 2d6 acid damage, AC 16, hp 25)  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 32, **Dex** 10, **Con** 22, **Int** 1, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 1  

**Base Atk** +11; **CMB** +26 (+30 grapple); **CMD** 36 (can’t be tripped)  

**Feats** Cleave, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Weapon Focus (bite), Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (slam), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md), [Lightning Reflexes](../../rules/feats/lightning-reflexes.md), [Iron Will](../../rules/feats/iron-will.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance and Toughness are one feat, Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Iron Will.*  

**Skills** Perception +6, Swim +31  

  

**Special Abilities**

 **Capsize (Ex)** A giant sea slug can attempt to capsize a boat or ship by ramming it as a charge attack and making a CMB check. The DC of this check is 25, or the result of the captain’s Profession (sailor) check, whichever is higher. For each size category the ship is larger than the sea slug’s size, the sea slug takes a cumulative -10 penalty on this CMB check.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate aquatic  

**Organization** solitary  

**Treasure** none
